AGENTIC COMMERCE: DISTRIBUTION STACK | G3-G6
|
|-- Discovery: Catalog
|   |-- [S] 1B+ product pages structured with current price and inventory.
|   |-- [S] Attributes include size, color and material; live across merchants.
|   |-- [S] API/MCP connection gives agents access to product data.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2026: Shop sign-in enables returning-buyer personalization.
|-- Transaction: UCP and Shopify checkout infrastructure
|   |-- [S] Open standard co-developed with Google; introduced early 2026.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: Stripe joined the UCP Governing Council.
|   |-- [S] Q2: product access, carts and checkout preserve merchant rules.
|   `-- [S] Partner front ends can use Shopify's processing/payments back end.
|-- Reach and trust
|   |-- [S] Q4 2025 call: Agentic plan announced for non-Shopify brands.
|   |-- [S] May 2026: admin section adds AI-channel attribution and guidance.
|   |-- [S] Q3: Shop Pay as agent wallet, including beyond Shopify stores.
|   `-- [S] shop.dev + Shop MCP package developer access to commerce tools.
|
|-- Momentum (all management figures; comparison periods matter)
|   |                 Q1 2026       Q2 2026       Q3 2026
|   |-- [S] Traffic   8x YoY        3x YoY        2.6x YoY
|   |-- [S] Orders    nearly 13x    3x            3.3x       (YoY)
|   |-- [S] AI conversion vs organic: nearly +80% Q2; +64% Q3.
|   |-- [S] Catalog conversion vs general AI search: 2x.
|   `-- [I] Different comparators; no mix adjustment or controlled test given.
|
|-- Long tail -[D:data]-> category distribution of AI sales
|   |-- [S] Q2 and Q3: three-quarters outside the top 100 categories.
|   `-- [I] Without all-channel category shares, no relative tilt is established.
|
`-- Revenue weight -[D:untestable]-> material contribution
    |-- [S] Q2: agentic volume small relative to total GMV of $116B.
    |-- [S] Q3: volume still small.
    |-- [S] Online-store economics; no separate agentic fees.
    `-- [I] Growth multiples do not reveal absolute volume or incrementality.

[I] The stack is a management-described mechanism, not proof of demand creation.
[I] ACP, Universal Cart and Checkout Kit appear in the seed but lack
    matching detail in the supplied excerpts; no protocol comparison asserted.
